subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw keep key-free managed `web_search` providers explicit opt-in, or allow implicit fallback to providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and shipped policy require explicit selection; changing that is an outbound provider-routing and user-consent decision rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve the shipped policy and treat the remaining UX gap as diagnostics/setup guidance rather than automatic keyless fallback.

options.title: Approve implicit keyless fallback
options.body: Allow the linked PR direction only if runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof are aligned with the new policy.

options.title: Close or narrow the issue
options.body: If maintainers reaffirm the shipped policy, close this issue after preserving the current workaround and the diagnostics improvement as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve the shipped policy and treat the remaining UX gap as diagnostics/setup guidance rather than automatic keyless fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that this issue and the linked PR would reverse.
